title: PointOne Joins Claude for Legal | PointOne
summary: PointOne is now part of Claude for Legal. Lawyers can log, fix, and release time and check billing compliance without leaving Claude.
body_markdown:
**NEW YORK — October 28, 2026** — PointOne is part of Anthropic's Claude for Legal. Today, Anthropic expanded Claude for Legal with a gallery of ready-to-use legal artifacts and more than 60 legal connectors. PointOne's connector brings AI timekeeping to Claude for Legal, so lawyers can manage their time, check billing compliance, and get insights into matter performance without leaving Claude. The connector is available today in Claude's connector directory for firms that use PointOne.


Read Anthropic's announcement:[Introducing artifacts for legal work with Claude](https://claude.com/resources/articles/introducing-artifacts-for-legal-work) .


Lawyers already bring their research, drafting, and review to Claude. Legal professionals are now the most engaged Claude Cowork users of any knowledge-work function. Until now, questions about their own time lived in a separate system. With PointOne connected, lawyers can ask their time data anything.


"AI is changing how legal work gets done, but firms also need to understand that work and its economics," said Jeremy Ben-Meir, CTO and Co-founder of PointOne. "By connecting PointOne to Claude, we're making the data behind legal work accessible where lawyers already work, helping firms move from simply capturing time to understanding and improving how work gets done."


### How PointOne works in Claude for Legal


PointOne still captures time automatically as work happens. The connector gives lawyers a faster way to review, correct, and act on that time from Claude. With their approval, Claude can:


-


**Review** time entries and captured-activity suggestions, summarize time, and check compliance findings before anything goes out.


-


**Log and fix** time, up to 100 entries at once, including narratives, matters, and duplicates.


-


**Release** finished time for billing, after the lawyer reviews it.


A lawyer can ask, "What did I work on yesterday that isn't logged yet?" or "Are there any compliance problems in my time this week?" For setup steps, every permission, and more example prompts, see PointOne's[Claude for lawyers guide](https://pointone.com/blog/claude-for-lawyers-how-to-review-log-and-fix-your-time-with-pointone-in-claude) .


### Matter insights for firm leaders


PointOne admins with firm-wide access can ask Claude to summarize released time by client, matter, or timekeeper, or to check a matter's spending against its budget.


### Same permissions, same ethical walls


Claude signs in as the lawyer, so it can see only what that lawyer can already see in PointOne, and often less. Ethical walls apply to every read and every change, and screened matters stay hidden from Claude. Claude can't change another person's time, even for admins, and it can't undo a release. A firm or lawyer can revoke access at any time, and revocation takes effect within about a minute. Firms can review PointOne's[security and data protection practices](https://pointone.com/security) .


### Availability


The PointOne connector for Claude is available today to PointOne customers whose firm has enabled it. See[all PointOne integrations](https://pointone.com/integrations) .


### About PointOne


PointOne is the AI time entry and intelligence platform for law firms. Trusted by more than 250 law firms globally, including Am Law 50 firms, PointOne automates time entry end-to-end by using AI to create complete, compliant, invoice-ready timesheets. PointOne is backed by world-class investors, including Y Combinator, General Catalyst, Bessemer Venture Partners, and 8VC.


### About Anthropic


Anthropic is an AI safety and research company focused on building reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. Its flagship product, Claude, is an AI assistant designed to help individuals and organizations with complex tasks, from research and analysis to writing and coding. Learn more at[anthropic.com](https://www.anthropic.com/) .


### Claude for Legal and PointOne: FAQ


Claude for Legal is Anthropic's offering for legal teams. It launched in May 2026 and connects Claude to legal software through connectors, practice-area plugins, and ready-to-use legal artifacts. Anthropic expanded it on October 28, 2026.


Yes. PointOne is listed in Claude's legal connector directory as an Anthropic-verified connector. Firms that use PointOne can enable it today.


No. Claude signs in as the lawyer and follows PointOne's ethical walls, so screened matters stay hidden.


Releasing time needs a separate permission the lawyer approves. PointOne also tells Claude to confirm with the lawyer before releasing, but lawyers should always check what's about to be released.
